jobs.title: Applied Physicist/Engineer - ATLAS ITk (EP-ATL-TRK-2026-208-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the final integration of the ITk detector prior to installation in the experiment is a crucial step to validate the full functionality.

As an applied physicist or engineer in the CERN-ATL Team, you will join the Tracker section (EP-ATL-TRK) and work closely with personnel from the Detector Technologies Group (EP-DT) on the construction and integration of the ATLAS ITk Pixel System and its integration into the ATLAS ITk.
 Functions

• Reception testing of ITk Silicon Pixel Detector elements and testing of multi-module Pixel structures to be integrated into the ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.

• Testing and verification of integrated ITk Pixel Detector structures and services as well as combined testing with the ITk Strip Detector in the surface integration facility (SR1) at CERN.

• Deploy and improve software and hardware elements for integration testing and service validation (online, detector control, detector safety) for the Pixel Detector and the combined ITk.

• Document procedures and results for ITk integration testing and service validation and develop testing procedures for the ITk Detector after installation.

• Participate hands-on in the ITk Detector integration work in the surface cleanroom as well as the preparation of equipment for the different testing stages.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physicist or Engineering or a related field.

Experience:

• Proven experience in the construction and integration of silicon pixel detectors for high energy physics experiments.

• Proven experience in the testing and data analysis of silicon detector systems.

• Proven experience in silicon detector operation and quality control including the development, installation and commissioning of laboratory infrastructure.

• Experience in the development of DAQ/online software or detector control systems for silicon detector testing and operation.

• Demonstrated experience in working in a multi-disciplinary team and international collaboration, including physicists, engineers and technicians involved in work on detector construction.
 The following experience would be an advantage:

• Experience on interpreting CAD designs of mechanics components or cooling plant operation.

• Assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment.
 Technical competencies:

• Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.

• Assembly and integration of detectors.

• Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Development of application software.

• Assembly and integration of infrastructure for detectors or experimental facilities.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 08.11.2026 at 23:59 CET .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-208-LD
 Field of work: Applied Physics
 Benchmark Job Title: Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Il team ATLAS del CERN svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella costruzione del futuro Inner Tracker (ITk) in silicio ATLAS. In particolare, l'integrazione finale del rivelatore ITk prima dell'installazione nell'esperimento è un passaggio cruciale per convalidarne la piena funzionalità.

Come fisico applicato o ingegnere nel team CERN-ATL, entrerai a far parte della sezione Tracker (EP-ATL-TRK) e lavorerai a stretto contatto con il personale del Detector Technologies Group (EP-DT) sulla costruzione e integrazione del sistema ATLAS ITk Pixel e la sua integrazione nell'ATLAS ITk.
Funzioni

• Test di ricezione degli elementi del Rilevatore di Pixel in silicio ITk e test di strutture Pixel multimodulo da integrare nel Pixel Outer Barrel ITk.

• Test e verifica delle strutture e servizi integrati del Rilevatore di Pixel ITk, nonché test combinati con il Rivelatore a Striscie ITk presso la struttura di integrazione superficiale (SR1) del CERN.

• Implementare e migliorare elementi software e hardware per i test di integrazione e la validazione del servizio (online, controllo del rilevatore, sicurezza del rilevatore) per il Pixel Detector e l'ITk combinato.

• Documentare le procedure e i risultati per i test di integrazione ITk e la validazione del servizio e sviluppare procedure di test per il rilevatore ITk dopo l'installazione.

• Partecipare direttamente al lavoro di integrazione del rilevatore ITk nella sala bianca di superficie, nonché alla preparazione delle apparecchiature per le diverse fasi di test.

Laurea magistrale o esperienza equivalente rilevante nel campo del Fisico Applicato o dell'Ingegneria o in un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Esperienza comprovata nella costruzione e integrazione di rivelatori di pixel al silicio per esperimenti di fisica ad alta energia.

• Esperienza comprovata nei test e nell'analisi dei dati di sistemi rivelatori al silicio.

• Esperienza comprovata nell'operazione e controllo qualità dei rivelatori di silicio, inclusi lo sviluppo, l'installazione e la messa in servizio delle infrastrutture di laboratorio.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di sistemi DAQ/software online o di controllo dei rivelatori per test e funzionamento di rilevatori al silicio.

• Esperienza dimostrata nel lavoro in team multidisciplinare e in collaborazioni internazionali, inclusi fisici, ingegneri e tecnici coinvolti nel lavoro sulla costruzione di rivelati.
La seguente esperienza sarebbe un vantaggio:

• Esperienza nell'interpretazione dei progetti CAD di componenti meccanici o nel funzionamento di impianti di raffreddamento.

• Assemblaggio di attrezzature sensibili in un ambiente di sala pulita.
Competenze tecniche:

• Test e validazione di componenti di rivelatore, acceleratore e linea di fascio.

• Assemblaggio e integrazione dei rivelatori.

• Costruzione, test e installazione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettromeccanici.

• Sviluppo di software applicativo.

• Assemblaggio e integrazione di infrastrutture per rivelatori o strutture sperimentali.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Raggiungere i risultati: consegnare un lavoro di alta qualità nei tempi previsti e soddisfare le aspettative.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattarsi rapidamente e con ingegno a priorità e requisiti in evoluzione.

• Lavorare in Team: costruire e mantenere relazioni lavorative costruttive ed efficaci.

• Gestire il sé: lavorare bene in modo autonomo; assumersi attività e compiti senza che venga invitato.

• Comunicare efficacemente: esprimere opinioni, idee e suggerimenti con convinzione e in modo logico/strutturato; mantenere il punto.
Competenze linguistiche:
Inglese parlato e scritto, con l'impegno a imparare il francese.

Idoneità e data di chiusura:
La diversità è stata parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Impiegare una forza lavoro diversificata è centrale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo candidature da tutti gli Stati Membri e degli Stati Membri Associati.
Questa vacanza sarà coperta il prima possibile e le domande dovrebbero normalmente arrivarci entro e non oltre il 08.11.2026 alle 23:59 CET.
Condizioni di impiego
Tipo di contratto: Contratto a durata limitata (4 anni). Salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orari di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità lavorativa: completamente in sede
Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavora in aree di radiazioni.

• Interventi in installazioni sotterranee.

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorano durante la notte, la domenica e i giorni festivi ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
Grado professionale: 6-7
Riferimento lavorativo: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-208-LD
Campo di lavoro: Fisica Applicata
Titolo di riferimento del lavoro: Fisico applicato

Benefici globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (esente da tasse), che aumenta in base agli anni di esperienza rilevanti.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura da parte del sistema assicurativo sanitario completo del CERN (per te, tuo coniuge e figli) e l'iscrizione al Fondo Pensione del CERN.

• Indennità mensili per famiglia, figli e neonati a seconda delle tue circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (sovvenzione per l'installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle tue circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di prorogare il contratto fino a 8 anni + idoneità per un contratto a tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione Europea per la Ricerca Nucleare, stiamo spingendo i confini della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti dai settori ingegneristico, tecnico, scientifico e amministrativo. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui innovazione e collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove sfide entusiasmanti e opportunità per contribuire a ricerche all'avanguardia che plasmano la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Affrontiamo queste sfide attraverso le prospettive diverse all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia apprezzato e promuovendo il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il nostro successo continuo.
Se sei pronto a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo dove la tua curiosità e le tue competenze possono prosperare. Fai parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa si trova al cuore dell'universo! PARTECIPA!
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the final integration of the ITk detector prior to installation in the experiment is a crucial step to validate the full functionality.

As an applied physicist or engineer in the CERN-ATL Team, you will join the Tracker section (EP-ATL-TRK) and work closely with personnel from the Detector Technologies Group (EP-DT) on the construction and integration of the ATLAS ITk Pixel System and its integration into the ATLAS ITk.
Functions

• Reception testing of ITk Silicon Pixel Detector elements and testing of multi-module Pixel structures to be integrated into the ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.

• Testing and verification of integrated ITk Pixel Detector structures and services as well as combined testing with the ITk Strip Detector in the surface integration facility (SR1) at CERN.

• Deploy and improve software and hardware elements for integration testing and service validation (online, detector control, detector safety) for the Pixel Detector and the combined ITk.

• Document procedures and results for ITk integration testing and service validation and develop testing procedures for the ITk Detector after installation.

• Participate hands-on in the ITk Detector integration work in the surface cleanroom as well as the preparation of equipment for the different testing stages.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physicist or Engineering or a related field.

Experience:

• Proven experience in the construction and integration of silicon pixel detectors for high energy physics experiments.

• Proven experience in the testing and data analysis of silicon detector systems.

• Proven experience in silicon detector operation and quality control including the development, installation and commissioning of laboratory infrastructure.

• Experience in the development of DAQ/online software or detector control systems for silicon detector testing and operation.

• Demonstrated experience in working in a multi-disciplinary team and international collaboration, including physicists, engineers and technicians involved in work on detector construction.
The following experience would be an advantage:

• Experience on interpreting CAD designs of mechanics components or cooling plant operation.

• Assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment.
Technical competencies:

• Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.

• Assembly and integration of detectors.

• Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Development of application software.

• Assembly and integration of infrastructure for detectors or experimental facilities.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 08.11.2026 at 23:59 CET .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-208-LD
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark Job Title: Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
Das CERN ATLAS-Team spielt eine bedeutende Rolle beim Bau des zukünftigen Silizium-ATLAS Inner Trackers (ITk). Insbesondere ist die endgültige Integration des ITk-Detektors vor der Installation im Experiment ein entscheidender Schritt, um die volle Funktionalität zu validieren.

Als angewandter Physiker oder Ingenieur im CERN-ATL-Team treten Sie der Tracker-Sektion (EP-ATL-TRK) bei und arbeiten eng mit Mitarbeitern der Detector Technologies Group (EP-DT) an der Entwicklung und Integration des ATLAS ITk Pixel Systems sowie dessen Integration in das ATLAS ITk zusammen.
Funktionen

• Empfangstests der ITk-Silizium-Pixeldetektorelemente und Tests von mehrmoduligen Pixelstrukturen, die in den ITk Pixel Outer Barrel integriert werden sollen.

• Tests und Verifizierung integrierter ITk-Pixeldetektorstrukturen und -dienste sowie kombinierte Tests mit dem ITk-Streifendetektor in der Oberflächenintegrationsanlage (SR1) am CERN.

• Software- und Hardwareelemente für Integrationstests und Servicevalidierung (online, Detektorsteuerung, Detektorsicherheit) für den Pixel Detector und das kombinierte ITk bereitstellen und verbessern.

• Dokumentieren Sie Verfahren und Ergebnisse für ITk-Integrationstests und Servicevalidierung und entwickeln Sie Testverfahren für den ITk-Detektor nach der Installation.

• Beteiligt sich praktisch an der ITk-Detektor-Integration im Oberflächenreinraum sowie an der Vorbereitung von Geräten für die verschiedenen Testphasen.

Masterabschluss oder gleichwertige relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Angewandter Physik oder Ingenieurwesen oder eines verwandten Bereichs.

Erfahrung:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Bau und der Integration von Siliziumpixeldetektoren für Hochenergiephysik-Experimente.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Prüfung und Datenanalyse von Siliziumdetektorsystemen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Bedienung und Qualitätskontrolle von Siliziumdetektoren, einschließlich der Entwicklung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Laborinfrastruktur.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von DAQ/Online-Software oder Detektorsteuerungssystemen für Siliziumdetektortests und -betrieb.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem multidisziplinären Team und in internationaler Zusammenarbeit, darunter Physiker, Ingenieure und Techniker, die am Bau von Detektoren tätig sind.
Folgende Erfahrung wäre ein Vorteil:

• Erfahrung in der Interpretation von CAD-Entwürfen von mechanischen Komponenten oder dem Betrieb von Kühlanlagen.

• Montage sensibler Geräte in einer Reinraumumgebung.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Prüfung und Validierung von Komponenten von Detektoren, Beschleunigern und Strahlleitungen.

• Montage und Integration von Detektoren.

• Bau, Test und Installation elektromechanischer Geräte und Systeme.

• Entwicklung von Anwendungssoftware.

• Montage und Integration von Infrastruktur für Detektoren oder Versuchsanlagen.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Ergebnisse erzielen: Hochwertige Arbeit pünktlich liefern und Erwartungen erfüllen.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: Sich schnell und einfallsreich an sich ändernde Prioritäten und Anforderungen anpassen.

• Teamarbeit: konstruktive und effektive Arbeitsbeziehungen aufbauen und pflegen.

• Selbstmanagement: Gut autonom arbeiten; Aktivitäten und Aufgaben ohne Aufforderung übernehmen.

• Effektive Kommunikation: Meinungen, Ideen und Vorschläge mit Überzeugung und logisch/strukturiert äußern; auf den Punkt bleiben.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Gesprochenes und geschriebenes Englisch, mit dem Ziel, Französisch zu lernen.

Berechtigung und Abschlussdatum:
Vielfalt ist seit der Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission von CERN und ein etablierter Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese Vakanz wird so bald wie möglich besetzt, und die Bewerbungen sollten normalerweise spätestens am 08.11.2026 um 23:59 CET eingehen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen
Vertragsart: Vertrag mit begrenzter Laufzeit (4 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Stelle beantragen.
Arbeitszeiten: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Jobflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
Diese Position umfasst:

• Arbeiten Sie in Strahlenbereichen.

• Interventionen in unterirdischen Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten Sie nachts, sonntags und an offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.
Berufsstufe: 6-7
Stellenreferenz: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-208-LD
Arbeitsfeld: Angewandte Physik
Benchmark-Berufsbezeichnung: Angewandter Physiker

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das sich mit deinen Jahren relevanter Erfahrung erhöht.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Absicherung durch das umfassende Krankenversicherungssystem des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) sowie die Mitgliedschaft im CERN-Pensionsfonds.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen je nach individueller Situation.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Entfernung, Reisekosten) je nach individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag um bis zu 8 Jahre zu verlängern + Berechtigung für eine unbefristete Vertragslaufzeit.
Überblick über CERN – Entdecke eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, verschieben wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Chancen, zu Spitzenforschung beizutragen, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven unserer Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag geschätzt wird und fördert unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Sinn. Vielfalt ist seit der Gründung ein Kernwert von CERN und bleibt zentral für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, inklusiven Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das Herz des Universums zu entdecken! MACHEN SIE MIT!
Weitere Informationen über uns finden Sie hier: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
L'équipe ATLAS du CERN joue un rôle majeur dans la construction du futur Inner Tracker (ITk) en silicium. En particulier, l'intégration finale du détecteur ITk avant son installation dans l'expérience est une étape cruciale pour valider la pleine fonctionnalité.

En tant que physicien appliqué ou ingénieur dans l'équipe CERN-ATL, vous rejoindrez la section Tracker (EP-ATL-TRK) et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le personnel du Detector Technologies Group (EP-DT) sur la construction et l'intégration du système ATLAS ITk Pixel et son intégration dans l'ATLAS ITk.
Fonctions

• Tests de réception des éléments du détecteur de pixels en silicium ITk et tests de structures de pixels multi-modules à intégrer dans le baril extérieur de pixels ITk.

• Tests et vérifications des structures et services intégrés du détecteur de pixels ITk ainsi que des tests combinés avec le détecteur à bandes ITk dans l'installation d'intégration de surface (SR1) du CERN.

• Déployer et améliorer les éléments logiciels et matériels pour les tests d'intégration et la validation de service (en ligne, contrôle du détecteur, sécurité du détecteur) pour le Pixel Detector et l'ITk combiné.

• Documenter les procédures et résultats pour les tests d'intégration ITk et la validation de service, et développer les procédures de test pour le détecteur ITk après installation.

• Participer directement aux travaux d'intégration du détecteur ITk dans la salle blanche de surface ainsi qu'à la préparation des équipements pour les différentes étapes de test.

Un master ou une expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine du physicien appliqué ou de l'ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience prouvée dans la construction et l'intégration de détecteurs de pixels en silicium pour des expériences de physique des hautes énergies.

• Expérience avérée dans les tests et l'analyse de données de systèmes de détection de silicium.

• Expérience avérée dans l'exploitation et le contrôle qualité de détecteurs au silicium, incluant le développement, l'installation et la mise en service des infrastructures de laboratoire.

• Expérience dans le développement de logiciels DAQ/en ligne ou de systèmes de contrôle de détecteurs pour les tests et l'exploitation de détecteurs au silicium.

• Expérience démontrée dans le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et en collaboration internationale, incluant physiciens, ingénieurs et techniciens impliqués dans la construction de détecteurs.
L'expérience suivante serait un avantage :

• Expérience dans l'interprétation des conceptions CAO de composants mécaniques ou du fonctionnement d'une installation de refroidissement.

• Assemblage d'équipements sensibles dans une salle blanche.
Compétences techniques :

• Tests et validation des composants du détecteur, de l'accélérateur et de la ligne de faisceau.

• Montage et intégration des détecteurs.

• Construction, test et installation d'équipements et systèmes électromécaniques.

• Développement de logiciels applicatifs.

• L'assemblage et l'intégration des infrastructures pour détecteurs ou installations expérimentales.
Compétences comportementales :

• Atteindre des résultats : livrer un travail de haute qualité dans les délais et répondre aux attentes.

• Démontrer la flexibilité : s'adapter rapidement et avec ingéniosité aux priorités et exigences changeantes.

• Travailler en équipe : construire et maintenir des relations de travail constructives et efficaces.

• Gérer soi : travailler de manière autonome ; assumer des activités et des tâches sans qu'on le demande.

• Communiquer efficacement : exprimer vos opinions, idées et suggestions avec conviction et de manière logique/structurée ; rester dans le but.
Compétences linguistiques :
Anglais parlé et écrit, avec l'engagement d'apprendre le français.

Éligibilité et date de clôture :
La diversité fait partie intégrante de la mission du CERN depuis sa fondation et constitue une valeur établie de l'Organisation. Employer une main-d'œuvre diversifiée est au cœur de notre réussite. Nous accueillons les candidatures de tous les États membres et des États membres associés.
Ce poste sera pourvu dès que possible, et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard le 08.11.2026 à 23h59 CET.
Conditions d'emploi
Type de contrat : Contrat à durée limitée (4 ans). Sous certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent postuler à un poste indéfini.
Heures de travail : 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité du poste : Entièrement sur site
Ce poste implique :

• Travaille dans les zones de radiation.

• Interventions dans des installations souterraines.

• Un permis de conduire valide.

• Travailler la nuit, le dimanche et les jours fériés officiels, selon les besoins de l'Organisation.
Grade du poste : 6-7
Référence du poste : EP-ATL-TRK-2026-208-LD
Domaine de travail : Physique appliquée
Titre de poste de référence : Physicien appliqué

Avantages mondiaux

• Un salaire compétitif (non imposable), qui augmente en fonction de vos années d'expérience pertinente.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime d'assurance santé complet du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants), ainsi que l'adhésion au Fonds de pension du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles familiales, enfants et nourrissons selon vos circonstances individuelles.

• Un package de relocalisation (subvention d'installation, déménagement, frais de déplacement) selon vos circonstances individuelles.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 8 ans + éligibilité à une durée indéterminée.
Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible !
Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur réunit non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi un large éventail de professionnels issus des domaines de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et des opportunités pour contribuer à des recherches de pointe qui façonnent notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux perspectives diverses de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et en alimentant notre sentiment partagé d'inclusion et de but. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle reste centrale à notre mission et à notre succès continu.
Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive repoussant les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent s'épanouir. Faites partie de notre mission pour découvrir ce qui se trouve au cœur de l'univers ! PARTICIPEZ !
Plus d'informations sur nous, ici : careers.cern

jobs.title: Digital ASIC Designer (EP-ESE-ME-2026-134-GRAP)
jobs.description:
Join CERN's EP-ESE-ME section in the development of a radiation-tolerant microcontroller ASIC for use in future particle physics detectors and accelerator systems. Operating in highly challenging radiation environments, these systems require robust and reliable embedded electronics.
 The project is based on an open-source RISC-V processing core and the CERN SOCRATES (System-On-Chip Radiation-Tolerant Ecosystem) framework for fault-tolerant SoC design. The successful candidate will contribute to the full development cycle, from requirements definition and system architecture to implementation, verification, and post-silicon validation.
 Your responsibilities:

• Analyse application requirements across CERN's accelerator complex and particle physics detector systems to define technical specifications for the microcontroller ASIC.

• Contribute to the architecture, design, and validation of a radiation-tolerant microcontroller ASIC implemented in 65 nm or 28 nm CMOS technology.

• Support the definition of the SoC architecture, including the selection and configuration of an appropriate RISC-V processing core.

• Design, integrate, and validate peripheral IP blocks within the CERN SOCRATES framework.

• Apply fault-tolerant design methodologies, including triple modular redundancy (TMR) and single-event upset (SEU) mitigation techniques.

• Participate in design verification activities and physical implementation, from RTL development through to tapeout.

• Contribute to post-silicon testing, characterisation, and validation following chip fabrication.
 Your profile:

• Strong understanding of digital logic design.

• Solid experience with digital IC design and RTL development (Verilog/SystemVerilog).

• Familiarity with standard ASIC design flows (synthesis, place and route, timing closure).

• Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and its ecosystem.

• Experience with microcontroller-based embedded systems development, including firmware programming in C and peripheral interfacing.
 Skills:

• RTL design and simulation (Verilog / SystemVerilog).

• Familiarity with the digital ASIC design flow, including synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure, and sign-off activities.

• Knowledge of fault-tolerant design techniques and radiation effects in CMOS circuits is an asset.

• Microcontroller embedded systems development (firmware in C, peripheral interfacing, bare-metal programming).

• Scripting and automation (Python or equivalent).

• Linux/Unix working environment.

• Curiosity and willingness to learn in a multidisciplinary environment.

• Ability to work independently as well as within a team.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Please provide at least 1 reference letter to support your application.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Electronics Engineer (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 03.11.2026 at 23:59 CET.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-January-2027
 Job reference: EP-ESE-ME-2026-134-GRAP
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark job: 200050 - Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields.  Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti alla sezione EP-ESE-ME del CERN nello sviluppo di un microcontrollore radio-tollerante ASIC per l'uso in futuri rivelatori di fisica delle particelle e sistemi di acceleratore. Operando in ambienti di radiazione altamente impegnativi, questi sistemi richiedono un'elettronica integrata robusta e affidabile.
Il progetto si basa su un nucleo di elaborazione RISC-V open-source e sul framework CERN SOCRATES (System-On-Chip Radiation-Tolerant Ecosystem) per la progettazione SoC tollerante dal difetto. Il candidato di successo contribuirà al ciclo di sviluppo completo, dalla definizione dei requisiti e dall'architettura del sistema all'implementazione, alla verifica e alla convalida post-silicon.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Analizzare i requisiti applicativi dei sistemi di rilevatori di fisica complessi e particelle del CERN per definire le specifiche tecniche per il microcontrollore ASIC.

• Contribuisci all'architettura, alla progettazione e alla validazione di un microcontrollore radio tollerante ASIC implementato nella tecnologia CMOS 65 nm o 28 nm.

• Sostenere la definizione dell'architettura SoC, compresa la selezione e la configurazione di un nucleo di elaborazione RISC-V appropriato.

• Progettare, integrare e convalidare i blocchi IP periferici nell'ambito del CERN SOCRATES.

• Applicare metodologie di progettazione tolleranti ai guasti, comprese le tecniche di mitigazione a tripla ridondanza modulare (TMR) e a singolo evento (SEU).

• Partecipa alle attività di verifica del design e all'implementazione fisica, dallo sviluppo di RTL fino al tapeout.

• Contribuisci a test post-silicon, caratterizzazione e validazione dopo la fabbricazione di chip.
Il tuo profilo:

• Forte comprensione del design della logica digitale.

• Esperienza solida con progettazione digitale IC e sviluppo RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog).

• Familiarità con flussi standard di design ASIC (sintesi, luogo e percorso, chiusura dei tempi).

• Conoscenza dell'architettura RISC-V e del suo ecosistema.

• Esperienza con lo sviluppo di sistemi incorporati basati su microcontroller, inclusa la programmazione del firmware in C e interfaccia periferica.
Competenze:

• RTL progettazione e simulazione (Verilog / SystemVerilog).

• Familiarità con il flusso digitale di design ASIC, tra cui sintesi, luogo e rotta, chiusura dei tempi e attività di sign-off.

• La conoscenza delle tecniche di progettazione e degli effetti di radiazione in circuiti CMOS è un bene.

• Sviluppo di sistemi incorporati Microcontroller (firmware in C, interfaccia periferica, programmazione bare-metal).

• Scrittura e automazione (Python o equivalente).

• ambiente di lavoro Linux/Unix.

• Curiosità e disponibilità ad imparare in un ambiente multidisciplinare.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e all'interno di una squadra.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Si prega di fornire almeno 1 lettera di riferimento per sostenere la vostra domanda.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Hai uno sfondo professionale in Electronics Engineer (o un campo correlato) e hanno o:
• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;

• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

Data di chiusura del lavoro: 03.11.2026 alle 23:59 CET.
Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join CERN's EP-ESE-ME section in the development of a radiation-tolerant microcontroller ASIC for use in future particle physics detectors and accelerator systems. Operating in highly challenging radiation environments, these systems require robust and reliable embedded electronics.
The project is based on an open-source RISC-V processing core and the CERN SOCRATES (System-On-Chip Radiation-Tolerant Ecosystem) framework for fault-tolerant SoC design. The successful candidate will contribute to the full development cycle, from requirements definition and system architecture to implementation, verification, and post-silicon validation.
Your responsibilities:

• Analyse application requirements across CERN's accelerator complex and particle physics detector systems to define technical specifications for the microcontroller ASIC.

• Contribute to the architecture, design, and validation of a radiation-tolerant microcontroller ASIC implemented in 65 nm or 28 nm CMOS technology.

• Support the definition of the SoC architecture, including the selection and configuration of an appropriate RISC-V processing core.

• Design, integrate, and validate peripheral IP blocks within the CERN SOCRATES framework.

• Apply fault-tolerant design methodologies, including triple modular redundancy (TMR) and single-event upset (SEU) mitigation techniques.

• Participate in design verification activities and physical implementation, from RTL development through to tapeout.

• Contribute to post-silicon testing, characterisation, and validation following chip fabrication.
Your profile:

• Strong understanding of digital logic design.

• Solid experience with digital IC design and RTL development (Verilog/SystemVerilog).

• Familiarity with standard ASIC design flows (synthesis, place and route, timing closure).

• Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and its ecosystem.

• Experience with microcontroller-based embedded systems development, including firmware programming in C and peripheral interfacing.
Skills:

• RTL design and simulation (Verilog / SystemVerilog).

• Familiarity with the digital ASIC design flow, including synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure, and sign-off activities.

• Knowledge of fault-tolerant design techniques and radiation effects in CMOS circuits is an asset.

• Microcontroller embedded systems development (firmware in C, peripheral interfacing, bare-metal programming).

• Scripting and automation (Python or equivalent).

• Linux/Unix working environment.

• Curiosity and willingness to learn in a multidisciplinary environment.

• Ability to work independently as well as within a team.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Please provide at least 1 reference letter to support your application.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Electronics Engineer (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 03.11.2026 at 23:59 CET.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-January-2027
Job reference: EP-ESE-ME-2026-134-GRAP
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark job: 200050 - Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

Diese Systeme, die in äußerst anspruchsvollen Strahlungsumgebungen arbeiten, erfordern eine robuste und zuverlässige eingebettete Elektronik.
Das Projekt basiert auf einem Open-Source-RISC-V-Prozessorkern und dem CERN SOCRATES (System-On-Chip Radiation-Tolerant Ecosystem) Framework für fehlertolerantes SoC-Design. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird zum gesamten Entwicklungszyklus beitragen, von der Anforderungsdefinition und Systemarchitektur bis hin zur Implementierung, Verifizierung und Post-Silizium-Validierung.
Ihre Aufgaben:

• Analysieren Sie die Anwendungsanforderungen in den CERN-Beschleunigerkomplex- und Partikelphysik-Detektorsystemen, um technische Spezifikationen für den Mikrocontroller-ASIC zu definieren.

• Beitrag zur Architektur, zum Design und zur Validierung eines strahlungstoleranten Mikrocontroller-ASIC, der in der 65-nm- oder 28-nm-CMOS-Technologie implementiert ist.

• Unterstützen Sie die Definition der SoC-Architektur, einschließlich der Auswahl und Konfiguration eines geeigneten RISC-V-Prozessorkerns.

• Anwendung fehlertoleranter Designmethoden, einschließlich dreifacher modularer Redundanz (TMR) und SEU-Abschwächungstechniken (Single-Event Supped).

• Beitrag zur Nachsiliziumprüfung, -charakterisierung und -validierung nach der Herstellung von Chips.

• Starkes Verständnis von digitalem Logikdesign.

• Fundierte Erfahrung mit digitalem IC-Design und RTL-Entwicklung (Verilog/SystemVerilog).

• Vertrautheit mit Standard-ASIC-Design-Flows (Synthese, Ort und Route, Timing-Schließung).

• Kenntnisse der RISC-V-Architektur und ihres Ökosystems.

• Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung von eingebetteten Systemen auf Mikrocontrollerbasis, einschließlich der Firmware-Programmierung in C und peripheren Schnittstellen.

• RTL Design und Simulation (Verilog / SystemVerilog).

• Vertrautheit mit dem digitalen ASIC-Designfluss, einschließlich Synthese, Ort-und-Route-, Timing-Schließung und Abmeldeaktivitäten.

• Das Wissen über fehlertolerante Designtechniken und Strahlungseffekte in CMOS-Schaltungen ist eine Bereicherung.

Rejoignez la section EP-ESE-ME du CERN dans le développement d'un microcontrôleur tolérant au rayonnement ASIC pour l'utilisation dans les futurs détecteurs de physique des particules et systèmes d'accélérateur. Fonctionnant dans des environnements de rayonnement très difficiles, ces systèmes nécessitent une électronique embarquée robuste et fiable.
Le projet s'appuie sur un noyau de traitement RISC-V ouvert et sur le cadre CERN SOCRATES (System-On-Chip Radiation-Tolerant Ecosystem) pour la conception de SoC tolérant les défauts. Le candidat retenu contribuera au cycle de développement complet, de la définition des exigences et de l'architecture du système à la mise en oeuvre, à la vérification et à la validation post-silicien.
Vos responsabilités :

• Analyser les exigences d'application dans les systèmes de détection de complexes d'accélérateurs et de particules du CERN pour définir les spécifications techniques du microcontrôleur ASIC.

• Contribuer à l'architecture, à la conception et à la validation d'un microcontrôleur ionisant ASIC mis en œuvre dans la technologie CMOS de 65 nm ou 28 nm.

• Soutenir la définition de l'architecture SoC, y compris la sélection et la configuration d'un noyau de traitement RISC-V approprié.

• Concevoir, intégrer et valider des blocs IP périphériques dans le cadre du CERN SOCRATES.

• Appliquer des méthodes de conception tolérantes aux défauts, y compris des techniques de redondance modulaire triple (TMR) et d'atténuation des perturbations à un seul événement (SEU).

• Participer aux activités de vérification de la conception et à la mise en oeuvre physique, depuis le développement du RTL jusqu'à l'enregistrement.

• Contribuer à l'essai, à la caractérisation et à la validation post-silicien après la fabrication des puces.
Votre profil:

• Forte compréhension de la conception logique numérique.

• Solide expérience avec la conception numérique IC et le développement RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog).

• Familiarité avec les flux standard de conception ASIC (synthèse, lieu et itinéraire, fermeture de la chronologie).

• Connaissance de l'architecture RISC-V et de son écosystème.

• Expérience du développement de systèmes intégrés à base de microcontrôleurs, y compris la programmation de micrologiciels en C et en interface périphérique.
Compétences :

• Conception et simulation RTL (Vérilog / SystemVérilog).

• Familiarité avec le flux numérique de conception ASIC, y compris la synthèse, le lieu et l'itinéraire, la fermeture du calendrier et les activités d'approbation.

• La connaissance des techniques de conception tolérantes aux défauts et des effets des rayonnements dans les circuits CMOS est un atout.

• Développement de systèmes intégrés Microcontroller (firmware en C, interface périphérique, programmation en métal nu).

• Script et automatisation (Python ou équivalent).

• Environnement de travail Linux/Unix.

• Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre dans un environnement multidisciplinaire.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et au sein d'une équipe.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Veuillez fournir au moins une lettre de référence à l'appui de votre demande.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en ingénieur électronique (ou dans un domaine connexe) et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;

• ou d'un doctorat d'au plus trois ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

Date de clôture de l'emploi: 03.11.2026 à 23:59 CET.
Durée du contrat : 24 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation jusqu'à 36 mois maximum.
Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place
Date de début prévue : 01 janvier 2027
Référence professionnelle: EP-ESE-ME-2026-134-GRAP
Domaine de travail: génie électrique ou électronique
Travail de référence : 200050 - Ingénieur en électronique

Avantages globaux

• Une allocation mensuelle nette de 6372 ou 7004 francs suisses par mois selon votre diplôme.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime complet d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

jobs.description:
Role and composition of the IC
 The functions of the IC are laid down in Article I 2.10 of the Fund’s rules and, amongst other things, include making proposals to the PFGB regarding the Fund’s Statement of Investment Principles, reviewing the Fund’s investment performance, and monitoring the Fund’s risk tolerance.
 The composition of the IC is laid down in Article I 2.11 of the Fund’s rules. The IC is required to have at least four members, comprising two members of the Governing Board appointed by the latter, two external professional experts appointed by the Governing Board, and any additional member(s) that the Governing Board may decide to appoint, who can be either Governing Board members with relevant experience or external experts.
 The members of the IC are appointed for a maximum period of three years, renewable once for a further maximum consecutive period of three years.
 Description of work
 The IC holds four meetings per year, including a joint meeting with the PFGB, but additional meetings or conference calls may be scheduled if required. Typically, meetings last a full day and take place at CERN in Geneva, Switzerland. Professional members are expected to attend every IC meeting. Professional members are required to act in the best interests of the Fund and to abide by the CERN Code of Conduct and the Guidelines for implementation of said Code .

Qualifications and requirements
 Candidates are required to possess deep and extensive experience of overseeing the asset management processes of large pension funds, or similar long-term institutional investors, such as endowments, foundations, and sovereign wealth funds.
 Candidates should have academic and/or professional qualifications and practitioner experience in some or all of the following areas:

• Long term asset studies

• Portfolio construction

• Investment risk management

• Equities

• Fixed income

• Real estate

• Private equity

• Hedge funds

• Other asset classes including infrastructure, timber, farmland, and commodities

Fees
 A market-competitive fee will be payable to external experts appointed who are not in the employment of CERN or ESO. Further information shall be provided at the selection stage.
 Applications
 Interested persons should apply with a CV (.PDF format) by clicking "I'm interested" on this link.
 Deadlines
 Applications will be accepted until 15 November 2026 . Interviews for selected candidates will take place by Zoom videoconference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ruolo e composizione dell'IC
Le funzioni dell’IC sono disposte all’articolo I 2.10 del regolamento del Fondo e, tra l’altro, includono la presentazione di proposte al PFGB in merito alla dichiarazione dei principi di investimento del Fondo, la revisione delle prestazioni di investimento del Fondo e il monitoraggio della tolleranza di rischio del Fondo.
La composizione dell’IC è stabilita all’articolo 1,1 del regolamento del Fondo. L'IC è tenuto ad avere almeno quattro membri, che comprendono due membri del consiglio di amministrazione nominati da quest'ultimo, due esperti professionali esterni nominati dal consiglio di amministrazione, e qualsiasi membro aggiuntivo(i) che il consiglio di amministrazione può decidere di nominare, che possono essere membri del consiglio di amministrazione con esperienza rilevante o esperti esterni.
I membri dell'IC sono nominati per un periodo massimo di tre anni, rinnovabile una volta per un ulteriore periodo massimo consecutivo di tre anni.
Descrizione del lavoro
L'IC tiene quattro riunioni all'anno, tra cui una riunione congiunta con il PFGB, ma possono essere programmate riunioni aggiuntive o conferenze, se necessario. Tipicamente, gli incontri durano una giornata intera e si svolgono al CERN di Ginevra, in Svizzera. I membri professionali sono tenuti a partecipare ad ogni incontro IC. I membri professionali sono tenuti ad agire nei migliori interessi del Fondo e a rispettare il codice di condotta del CERN e le linee guida per l'attuazione di detto codice .

Qualifiche e requisiti
I candidati sono tenuti a possedere una profonda e vasta esperienza di supervisionare i processi di gestione patrimoniale di grandi fondi pensione, o simili investitori istituzionali a lungo termine, come doti, fondazioni e fondi di ricchezza sovrana.
I candidati dovrebbero avere qualifiche accademiche e/o professionali e l'esperienza praticante in alcune o tutte le seguenti aree:

• Studi sugli asset a lungo termine

• Portfolio costruzione

• Gestione dei rischi di investimento

• Equità

• Reddito fisso

• Immobiliare

• Equità privata

• Fondi di copertura

• Altre classi di asset tra cui infrastrutture, legname, terreni agricoli e materie prime

Tasse
Una quota di mercato-competitiva sarà pagabile ad esperti esterni nominati che non sono nell'occupazione del CERN o dell'ESO. Ulteriori informazioni sono fornite nella fase di selezione.
Applicazioni
Le persone interessate dovrebbero applicarsi con un CV (formato PDF) cliccando su "Sono interessato" su questo link.
Scadenza
Le domande saranno accettate fino al 15 novembre 2026 . Le interviste per i candidati selezionati avranno luogo tramite Zoom videoconferenza.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Rolle und Zusammensetzung des IK
Die Funktionen des IC sind in Artikel I 2.10 der Fondsordnung festgelegt und umfassen unter anderem Vorschläge an den PFGB bezüglich der Anlagegrundsätze des Fonds, die Überprüfung der Anlageperformance des Fonds und die Überwachung der Risikotoleranz des Fonds.
Die Zusammensetzung des IC ist in Artikel I 2.11 der Fondsregelung festgelegt. Das IC muss aus mindestens vier Mitgliedern bestehen, die aus zwei von diesem ernannten Mitgliedern des Verwaltungsrats, zwei vom Verwaltungsrat ernannten externen Sachverständigen und einem oder mehreren zusätzlichen Mitgliedern bestehen müssen, deren Ernennung der Verwaltungsrat beschließen kann und die entweder Mitglieder des Verwaltungsrats mit einschlägiger Erfahrung oder externe Sachverständige sein können.
Die Mitglieder des IC werden für einen Zeitraum von höchstens drei Jahren ernannt und können einmal um einen weiteren Zeitraum von höchstens drei Jahren in Folge ernannt werden.
Beschreibung der Arbeiten
Der IC hält vier Sitzungen pro Jahr ab, einschließlich einer gemeinsamen Sitzung mit dem PFGB, aber bei Bedarf können zusätzliche Sitzungen oder Telefonkonferenzen geplant werden. Normalerweise dauern Meetings einen ganzen Tag und finden am CERN in Genf, Schweiz, statt. Von professionellen Mitgliedern wird erwartet, dass sie an jedem IC-Meeting teilnehmen. Professionelle Mitglieder sind verpflichtet, im besten Interesse des Fonds zu handeln und sich an den CERN-Verhaltenskodex und die Richtlinien für die Umsetzung dieses Kodex zu halten.

Qualifikationen und Anforderungen
Die Kandidaten müssen über umfassende und umfassende Erfahrung in der Überwachung der Vermögensverwaltungsprozesse großer Pensionsfonds oder ähnlicher langfristiger institutioneller Anleger wie Stiftungen, Stiftungen und Staatsfonds verfügen.
Die Kandidaten sollten über akademische und/oder berufliche Qualifikationen und Erfahrung in einigen oder allen der folgenden Bereiche verfügen:

• Langfristige Asset-Studien

• Portfolioaufbau

• Anlagerisikomanagement

• Aktien

• Fixed Income

• Immobilien

• Private Equity

• Hedgefonds

• Sonstige Anlageklassen einschließlich Infrastruktur, Holz, Ackerland und Rohstoffe

Gebühren
Eine marktübliche Gebühr wird an externe Experten gezahlt, die nicht bei CERN oder ESO beschäftigt sind. Weitere Informationen sind in der Auswahlphase vorzulegen.
Anträge
Interessierte Personen sollten sich mit einem CV (.PDF-Format) bewerben, indem sie auf diesem Link auf "Ich bin interessiert" klicken.
Fristen
Anträge werden bis zum 15. November 2026 angenommen. Interviews für ausgewählte Kandidaten finden per Zoom-Videokonferenz statt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rôle et composition du CI
Les fonctions du CI sont définies à l'article I 2.10 des règles du Fonds et comprennent, entre autres, la présentation de propositions au PFGB concernant la déclaration des principes d'investissement du Fonds, l'examen de la performance du Fonds en matière d'investissement et le suivi de la tolérance au risque du Fonds.
La composition du CI est définie à l'article I 2.11 du règlement du Fonds. La CI est tenue d'avoir au moins quatre membres, comprenant deux membres du conseil de direction nommés par ce dernier, deux experts professionnels externes nommés par le conseil de direction, et tout membre supplémentaire que le conseil de direction peut décider de nommer, qui peut être soit des membres du conseil de direction ayant une expérience pertinente, soit des experts externes.
Les membres du CI sont nommés pour une période maximale de trois ans, renouvelable une fois pour une nouvelle période maximale consécutive de trois ans.
Description des travaux
Le CI tient quatre réunions par an, y compris une réunion conjointe avec le PFGB, mais des réunions supplémentaires ou des conférences téléphoniques peuvent être prévues au besoin. Généralement, les réunions durent une journée entière et ont lieu au CERN à Genève, en Suisse. Les membres professionnels sont tenus d'assister à chaque réunion d'IC. Les membres professionnels sont tenus d'agir dans l'intérêt supérieur du Fonds et de respecter le code de conduite du CERN et les lignes directrices pour la mise en œuvre dudit code .

Qualifications et exigences
Les candidats doivent posséder une expérience approfondie et approfondie de la supervision des processus de gestion des actifs des grands fonds de pension, ou d'investisseurs institutionnels à long terme similaires, comme les fonds de dotation, les fondations et les fonds souverains.
Les candidats doivent posséder des qualifications universitaires et/ou professionnelles et une expérience pratique dans certains des domaines suivants ou dans tous les domaines suivants:

• Études d'actifs à long terme

• Construction de portefeuilles

• Gestion des risques d'investissement

• Équités

• Revenu fixe

• Immobilier

• Capitaux propres

• Fonds de couverture

• Autres catégories d'actifs, y compris les infrastructures, le bois, les terres agricoles et les produits de base

Frais
Les experts externes nommés qui ne sont pas employés par le CERN ou l'ESO devront payer une redevance de concurrence sur le marché. Des informations complémentaires sont fournies au stade de la sélection.
Demandes
Les personnes intéressées doivent présenter une demande de CV (format PDF) en cliquant sur « Je suis intéressé » sur ce lien.
Délais
Les candidatures seront acceptées jusqu'au 15 novembre 2026 . Les entrevues pour les candidats sélectionnés auront lieu par visioconférence Zoom.

jobs.title: Data Privacy Specialist (CIO-2026-209-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 As a Data Privacy Specialist, you will join the Office of Data Privacy (ODP) in the Office of the CIO. ODP is CERN’s independent and impartial centre of expertise in the area of data privacy. You will report to the Data Privacy Advisor, CERN’s Data Protection Officer, and will advise CERN Management as well as Data Subjects and External Entities involved in the Processing of Personal Data, on all issues related to the Organization’s data privacy protection.
 Functions

• Provide specialised legal and operational advice to ensure that CERN's processing of personal data complies with applicable data privacy protection requirements throughout the data lifecycle, including projects, contracts, risk assessments, data transfers, and data breach response, taking into account data protection implications of emerging technologies.

• Manage or contribute to projects in the privacy and data protection field involving internal and external stakeholders (e.g. international data-sharing initiatives).

• Advise on the relevant governance structures, policies, documentation, stakeholder engagement, and establish and maintain regulatory relationships necessary to support CERN's data privacy protection framework.

• Ensure the effective exercise of data subject rights and the prompt handling of grievances and complaints.

• Promote a strong culture of data privacy protection through communication, awareness campaigns, guidance materials, and targeted training for CERN personnel and stakeholders.

• Oversee the effectiveness of CERN's data privacy protection framework, identify improvement opportunities, and ensure ongoing alignment with evolving regulatory expectations and recognised best practices.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Law, Data Protection, Privacy, IT or a related field.
 Holding a certification in the domain of data privacy protection (e.g. International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP)), or equivalent, or admission to the bar or equivalent legal qualification would be an asset.
 Experience:

• You have proven data protection expertise and experience.

• You have extensive practical experience in data protection acquired at national or international level, in particular practical experience in applying data protection rules (preferably EU data protection framework).

• You preferably have experience working in an international environment and in dealing with EU actors and bodies or Inter-Governmental Organizations (IGOs).

• You will act with the required independence and impartiality.
 Technical competencies:

• Knowledge of EU regulations.

• Knowledge of administrative rules and procedures.

• Drafting and writing of official documents.

• Stakeholder relationship management, in particular data protection commissions, communities of DPOs of other IGOs.

• Risks assessment for compliance and data protection purposes.

• Compliance auditing.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: being willing to work on different projects simultaneously.

• Demonstrating Accountability: maintaining confidentiality.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written both English and French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 09.11.2026 at 23:59 CET .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Hybrid
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: CIO-2026-209-LD
 Field of work: Legal
 Benchmark Job Title: Legal Adviser

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
In qualità di Data Privacy Specialist, ti unirai all'Ufficio della Privacy (ODP) nell'Ufficio del CIO. ODP è il centro di competenza indipendente e imparziale del CERN nel settore della privacy dei dati. Ti riferirai al Data Privacy Advisor, Responsabile della protezione dei dati del CERN, e consiglierà la Gestione del CERN, nonché gli Soggetti e le Entità esterne coinvolte nel trattamento dei dati personali, su tutte le questioni relative alla protezione della privacy dell’Organizzazione.
Funzioni

• Fornire consulenza legale e operativa specializzata per garantire che il trattamento dei dati personali del CERN sia conforme ai requisiti di protezione della privacy dei dati applicabili in tutto il ciclo di vita dei dati, inclusi progetti, contratti, valutazioni dei rischi, trasferimenti di dati e risposta alla violazione dei dati, tenendo conto delle implicazioni sulla protezione dei dati delle tecnologie emergenti.

• Gestire o contribuire a progetti nel campo della privacy e della protezione dei dati che coinvolgono stakeholder interni ed esterni (ad esempio iniziative internazionali di condivisione dei dati).

• Consigliare le relative strutture di governance, politiche, documentazione, impegno degli stakeholder, e stabilire e mantenere i rapporti normativi necessari per sostenere il quadro di protezione della privacy dei dati del CERN.

• Assicurare l'effettivo esercizio dei diritti dell'interessato e il tempestivo trattamento dei reclami.

• Promuovere una forte cultura della protezione della privacy dei dati attraverso la comunicazione, campagne di sensibilizzazione, materiali di orientamento e formazione mirata per il personale e gli stakeholder del CERN.

• Superare l'efficacia del framework di protezione della privacy dei dati del CERN, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e garantire un allineamento continuo con le aspettative normative in evoluzione e le best practice riconosciute.

Laurea magistrale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della legge, protezione dei dati, privacy, IT o un campo relativo.
Tenere una certificazione nel campo della protezione della privacy dei dati (ad esempio International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP)), o equivalente, o l'ammissione alla barra o equivalente qualifica legale sarebbe un bene.
Esperienza:

• Hai dimostrato esperienza e competenza nella protezione dei dati.

• L'utente ha un'ampia esperienza pratica nella protezione dei dati acquisita a livello nazionale o internazionale, in particolare nell'applicazione delle norme sulla protezione dei dati (preferibilmente nel quadro della protezione dei dati dell'UE).

• Preferibilmente avete esperienza nel lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e nel trattare con attori e organismi UE o organizzazioni inter-governative (IGO).

• Agirà con la necessaria indipendenza e imparzialità.
Competenze tecniche:

• Conoscenza delle normative UE.

• Conoscenza delle regole e delle procedure amministrative.

• redazione e scrittura di documenti ufficiali.

• Gestione delle relazioni degli stakeholder, in particolare le commissioni di protezione dei dati, le comunità di DPO di altre IGO.

• Valutazione dei rischi per le finalità di conformità e protezione dei dati.

• Controllo di conformità.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Comunicare efficacemente: fornire presentazioni in modo strutturato e chiaro; regolare lo stile e il contenuto al pubblico; rispondere con calma e con fiducia alle domande.

• Realizzare risultati: avere un approccio strutturato e organizzato verso il lavoro; essere in grado di fissare priorità e pianificare i compiti con i risultati in mente.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: essere disposti a lavorare su diversi progetti contemporaneamente.

• Dimostrare la responsabilità: mantenere la riservatezza.
Capacità linguistiche:
Ha parlato e scritto sia inglese che francese.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il più presto possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 09.11.2026 a 23:59 CET .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Grado di lavoro: 6-7
Riferimento del lavoro: CIO-2026-209-LD
Campo di lavoro: Legale
Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Consigliere legale

Vantaggi globali

• Un salario competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con i vostri anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo dove l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno, affrontiamo nuove sfide e opportunità entusiasmanti per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!
Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
