Le groupe électrique du département d'ingénierie ( EN-EL ) est responsable de l'exploitation, de l'entretien et des travaux sur le réseau électrique du CERN. Au sein du Groupe Electrical, vous rejoindrez la Section de Gestion de Projet Électrique (EPM), chargée de la gestion des projets liés au réseau de transmission et de distribution électrique du CERN et à l'alimentation des futures infrastructures scientifiques.
Le télescope Einstein (ET ) est une installation souterraine proposée pour un observatoire gravitationnel de troisième génération. En s'appuyant sur le succès de Advanced Virgo et Advanced LIGO, qui ont détecté la fusion de trous noirs et d'étoiles à neutrons, ET aura une sensibilité beaucoup plus élevée. Cela sera réalisé avec des bras interféromètres de 10 km (au-dessus des 3 km de Virgo), une profondeur de 150-300 mètres sous terre, et de nouvelles technologies comme le refroidissement cryogénique de l'optique autour de 15K, des techniques quantiques pour réduire les fluctuations de la lumière, et des systèmes avancés de réduction du bruit. L'ET permettra d'explorer les ondes gravitationnelles de l'Univers jusqu'aux âges sombres cosmologiques, offrant des aperçus de la physique fondamentale et de la cosmologie.
Le projet ET est actuellement en phase «d'étude» et se transformera en projet d'exécution après son approbation.
Vos responsabilités
En tant qu'ingénieur électrique, vous soutiendrez la mission du groupe EN-EL, participant aux études du réseau électrique et de l'infrastructure du télescope Einstein.
Vos principales tâches seront les suivantes :

• Définir les besoins électriques avec les utilisateurs et produire la liste des charges électriques.

• Préparation de spécifications et de rapports conceptuels.

• Développer et utiliser des modèles des réseaux HV, MV et LV du télescope à l'aide d'applications logicielles disponibles sur le marché pour réaliser diverses études de systèmes électriques telles que débit de charge, court-circuit, stabilité transitoire, analyse harmonique, etc.

• Préparation des diagrammes de transmission et de distribution, des scénarios de mode de défaillance et des solutions d'alimentation de secours pour les installations de surface et souterraines.

• Contribuer à l'étude d'un déploiement potentiel des réseaux de stockage d'énergie, de contrôle du réseau, de FACTS et de DC.
Les tâches supplémentaires seront les suivantes :

• Fournir les intrants nécessaires et appuyer la préparation de la connexion au réseau.

• Effectuer des levés/effectuer des mesures sur les systèmes électriques existants du CERN (surface et sous-sol) et d'autres installations de télescopes similaires à l'échelle mondiale, le cas échéant, pour récupérer les informations utiles aux études.

• Appuyer l'élaboration de la facture des quantités et de l'estimation des coûts (CAPEX et OPEX).

• Définir et examiner les exigences des systèmes électriques et coordonner avec les autres membres de l'équipe d'étude la modélisation 3D de l'infrastructure électrique pour son intégration dans le modèle global et les travaux civils.

• Contribuer à l'étude (technologique) des nouvelles technologies dans le domaine de la distribution électrique qui pourraient être déployées sur le projet.

• Expérience dans le développement et l'utilisation des modèles pour les réseaux haute tension, moyenne tension et basse tension.

As computing evolves for the High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC) era, WLCG faces a rapidly growing computing demand alongside increasingly heterogeneous hardware environments (CPUs, GPUs, Cloud, and HPC).
 To guide procurement, resource pledging, performance studies and accounting, the High Energy Physics (HEP) community relies on domain-specific benchmarking tools to accurately measure and compare computing resources.
 As a Graduate / Applied Engineer (QUEST), you will join our team in CERN's IT Department to support the development, operation, and user support for WLCG HEPScore benchmarking services. You will contribute to key activities, helping to build and maintain the next-generation benchmarking software stack for the WLCG community.

• Service Maintenance & Enhancement: Ensure the smooth operation of the core benchmarking infrastructure and data ingestion services using Puppet, GitLab CI/CD, ActiveMQ, Logstash, OpenSearch, Kibana, Apache Spark and Grafana.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Worldwide LHC Computing Grid (WLCG) project is a global collaboration of around 170 computing centres in more than 40 countries, linking up national and international grid infrastructures. As computing evolves for the High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC) era, WLCG faces a rapidly growing computing demand alongside increasingly heterogeneous hardware environments (CPUs, GPUs, Cloud, and HPC).
To guide procurement, resource pledging, performance studies and accounting, the High Energy Physics (HEP) community relies on domain-specific benchmarking tools to accurately measure and compare computing resources.
As a Graduate / Applied Engineer (QUEST), you will join our team in CERN's IT Department to support the development, operation, and user support for WLCG HEPScore benchmarking services. You will contribute to key activities, helping to build and maintain the next-generation benchmarking software stack for the WLCG community.
Your responsibilities

• Software Development: Actively contribute to the development, packaging, and distribution of the HEP benchmark software stack. Integrate, profile, and validate production-level GPU application workloads from LHC experiment software (e.g., event generation, simulation, fast inference, and HLT).

• Containerisation: Build, test, and maintain container images of HEP workloads using automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

• Service Maintenance & Enhancement: Ensure the smooth operation of the core benchmarking infrastructure and data ingestion services using Puppet, GitLab CI/CD, ActiveMQ, Logstash, OpenSearch, Kibana, Apache Spark and Grafana.

• Performance Analysis: Collect, process, and analyze grid-wide benchmark data to evaluate performance scaling across diverse CPU/GPU architectures and server configurations.

• Technical Support: Provide technical support and documentation to the WLCG user community.
Your profile

• Advanced Python Development: Solid experience in Python programming,including modular code structure,packaging, distribution, and testing.

• Containerisation: Solid understanding of Docker and Apptainer/Singularity, along with familiarity with GPU container execution runtime environments.

• DevOps & Infrastructure Automation: Proficiency with GitLab CI/CD pipelines, container registries, configuration management (Puppet), and deployment methodologies.

• Linux Systems & Performance Profiling: Strong Linux administration and shell scripting skills. Experience in system metrics tracking (e.g., CPU/GPU utilisation, hardware performance metrics, power monitoring).

• Data Analytics Pipelines & Visualisation: Experience with monitoring and data analytics stacks such as OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Grafana, or Apache Spark.

• Communication & Collaboration: Good technical writing and communication skills to interact with domain experts across the global WLCG collaboration.
Skills

• Programming & Scripting: Python (code, packaging, testing), Bash, Git.

• Containerisation: Docker, Apptainer/Singularity.

• GPU Computing: NVIDIA Container Toolkit, CUDA, nvidia-smi, AMD ROCm, rocm-smi, GPU profiling.

• DevOps: GitLab CI/CD, Puppet, Linux administration.

• Monitoring & Data Analytics: OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Grafana, Apache Spark, ActiveMQ.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

descriptionByLocale.en:
The SY-BI group in CERN's Accelerator Systems Department develops and operates the instruments used to observe particle beams and measure their key properties. These systems are essential to the reliable operation, optimisation, and future development of CERN's accelerator complex.
You will contribute to the development of next-generation beam-position monitoring systems for CERN's injector complex, including the pre-accelerators and Antimatter Decelerator. You will work on innovative high-speed data-acquisition platforms combining fast digitisers with advanced System-on-Chip (SoC) technologies.
This role offers a hands-on opportunity to work at the intersection of digital electronics, embedded systems, real-time signal processing, and accelerator physics. It is particularly suited to people with an interest in FPGA or HDL development, high-speed electronics, embedded software, digital signal processing, instrumentation, or experimental physics.
Your responsibilities:

• Develop, integrate and test FPGA gateware and embedded SoC firmware for a SoC device.

• Implement data acquisition and data processing logic and real-time digital signal-processing algorithms.

• Validate system performance in laboratory and accelerator environments.

• Perform data analysis in Python.

• Assist measurement campaigns in the accelerator complex.

• Collaborate with experienced engineers, physicists, and technicians from different teams across CERN.
Your profile:

• Experience in digital signal processing.

• Demonstrated experience with FPGA and SoC.

• Experience in Software programming (e.g. Python, C++).

• Demonstrated experience with Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC and/or RFSoC would be an advantage.
Skills:

• Knowledge of Verilog and SystemVerilog.

• Knowledge of digital electronics.

• Knowledge of Python.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Electronic Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Die SY-BI-Gruppe in der Abteilung für Beschleunigersysteme des CERN entwickelt und betreibt die Instrumente zur Beobachtung von Teilchenstrahlen und zur Messung ihrer wichtigsten Eigenschaften. Diese Systeme sind für den zuverlässigen Betrieb, die Optimierung und die zukünftige Entwicklung des CERN-Beschleunigerkomplexes unerlässlich.
Sie werden zur Entwicklung von Strahlpositionsüberwachungssystemen der nächsten Generation für den Injektorkomplex des CERN beitragen, einschließlich der Vorbeschleuniger und des Antimaterie-Dezerlerators. Sie arbeiten an innovativen High-Speed-Datenerfassungsplattformen, die schnelle Digitalisierer mit fortschrittlichen System-on-Chip (SoC)-Technologien kombinieren.
Diese Rolle bietet eine praktische Möglichkeit, an der Schnittstelle von digitaler Elektronik, eingebetteten Systemen, Echtzeit-Signalverarbeitung und Beschleunigerphysik zu arbeiten. Es eignet sich besonders für Personen mit Interesse an FPGA- oder HDL-Entwicklung, Hochgeschwindigkeitselektronik, eingebetteter Software, digitaler Signalverarbeitung, Instrumentierung oder experimenteller Physik.

• Entwickeln, integrieren und testen Sie FPGA-Gateware und Embedded-SoC-Firmware für ein SoC-Gerät.

• Implementieren Sie Datenerfassungs- und Datenverarbeitungslogik und digitale Echtzeit-Signalverarbeitungsalgorithmen.

• Validierung der Systemleistung in Labor- und Beschleunigerumgebungen.

• Führen Sie Datenanalysen in Python durch.

• Unterstützung bei Messkampagnen im Beschleunigerkomplex.

• Arbeiten Sie mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren, Physikern und Technikern aus verschiedenen Teams des CERN zusammen.
Ihr Profil:

• Erfahrung in der digitalen Signalverarbeitung.

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung mit FPGA und SoC.

• Erfahrung in der Software-Programmierung (z.B. Python, C++).

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen mit Xilinx Zynq UltraScale + MPSoC und / oder RFSoC wären von Vorteil.

• Kenntnisse von Verilog und SystemVerilog.

• Kenntnisse der digitalen Elektronik.

• Wissen über Python.

• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitglieds oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats.

• einen Master-Abschluss mit 2 bis 6 Jahren Berufserfahrung nach dem Abschluss;

• Mettre en œuvre la logique d'acquisition et de traitement des données et les algorithmes numériques de traitement des signaux en temps réel.

• Valider les performances du système en laboratoire et en accélérateur.

• Effectuer une analyse de données en Python.

• Collaborez avec des ingénieurs, physiciens et techniciens expérimentés de différentes équipes du CERN.

• Expérience dans le traitement du signal numérique.

• Expérience démontrée avec FPGA et SoC.

• Expérience de la programmation logicielle (p. ex. Python, C++).

Compétences :

jobs.description:
Introduction
 The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing. As a mechanical/electromechanical technician in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment in the design and construction of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.
 Functions

• Participate in the production, testing and installation of the Pixel Outer System services and their support structures (e.g. trolleys).

• Support the design, manufacturing and installation of temporary services and infrastructure for testing during the integration of the Pixel Detector.

• Participate hands-on in the integration of the Pixel Outer System and its insertion into ITk in the SR1 cleanroom, contributing to the development and fabrication of the corresponding tooling.

• Participate in the ITk installation in the ATLAS cavern, supporting preparation of Pixel services for installation as well as connections after insertion.

• Document manufacturing and installation procedures as well QC information of tools and production parts to ensure traceability.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Precision Mechanics or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in conventional precision machining of metallic and non-metallic parts, using both conventional and non-conventional methods.

• Good understanding of mechanical and electrical drawings, including geometrical tolerance specifications.

• Demonstrated experience in the assembly of complex, high precision mechanical systems with high quality standards.

• Proven experience in manufacturing and installation of cable bundles and harnesses.

• Proven experience with of structural joining techniques, particularly adhesive bonding and orbital welding.
 Experience in the following areas would be considered an asset:

• Previous experience in computer numerically controlled (CNC) machines.

• Experience in the use of CAD software (ideally Catia V5) for the 2D and 3D modelling.

• Previous experience in CAD-CAM programming (preferably using WORKNC).
 Technical competencies:

• Manufacturing of mechanical parts.

• Knowledge and application of joining techniques, glueing, welding.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).

• Programming and use of CNC machine-tools and machining centres.

• Precision assembly of mechanical structures and equipment
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Solving Problems: adopting a pragmatic approach; understanding the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 29.11.2026 at 23:59 CET .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (3 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: EP-DT-EO-2026-215-LD
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

 Il CERN ATLAS Team svolge un ruolo importante nella costruzione del futuro ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). Le nostre attività includono la progettazione, la prototipazione e l'assemblaggio delle strutture di supporto e degli strumenti, nonché l'integrazione finale dei rivelatori, l'installazione e il test. In qualità di tecnico meccanico/elettromeccanico del CERN-DT Team, vi unirete alla sezione Engineering Office (EP-DT-EO) e lavorerete a stretto contatto con il personale del gruppo ATLAS (EP-ATL) e con il team di coordinamento tecnico dell'esperimento ATLAS nella progettazione e costruzione dell'ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.
 Funzioni

• Partecipano alla produzione, alla sperimentazione e all'installazione dei servizi Pixel Outer System e delle loro strutture di supporto (ad es. carrelli).

• Supporta la progettazione, la produzione e l'installazione di servizi temporanei e infrastrutture per il test durante l'integrazione del Pixel Detector.

• Partecipate all'integrazione del Pixel Outer System e al suo inserimento in ITk nella pulizia SR1, contribuendo allo sviluppo e alla fabbricazione della corrispondente utensile.

• Partecipa all'installazione ITk nella caverna ATLAS, supportando la preparazione dei servizi Pixel per l'installazione e le connessioni dopo l'inserimento.

• Le procedure di produzione e installazione dei documenti nonché le informazioni QC di strumenti e parti di produzione per garantire la tracciabilità.

Più alto diploma tecnico o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della meccanica di precisione o un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Esperienza dimostrata nella lavorazione di precisione convenzionale di parti metalliche e non metalliche, utilizzando metodi convenzionali e non convenzionali.

• Buona comprensione dei disegni meccanici ed elettrici, comprese le specifiche di tolleranza geometrica.

• Esperienza dimostrata nel montaggio di sistemi meccanici complessi e di alta precisione con elevati standard di qualità.

• Esperienza comprovata nella produzione e installazione di fasci di cavi e imbracature.

• Esperienza comprovata con tecniche di giunzione strutturale, in particolare incollaggio adesivo e saldatura orbitale.
 L'esperienza nelle seguenti aree sarebbe considerata un bene:

• Esperienza precedente nelle macchine a controllo numerico (CNC).

• Esperienza nell'uso del software CAD (idealmente Catia V5) per la modellazione 2D e 3D.

• Esperienza precedente nella programmazione CAD-CAM (preferibilmente utilizzando WORKNC).
 Competenze tecniche:

• Produzione di parti meccaniche.

• Conoscenza e applicazione di tecniche di giunzione, incollaggio, saldatura.

• Produzione di disegni 2D e modelli 3D (dimensionamento ISO, tolleranza).

• Programmazione e utilizzo di utensili CNC e centri di lavorazione.

• Montaggio di precisione delle strutture meccaniche e delle attrezzature
 Competenze comportamentali:

• Ottenere risultati: fornire lavoro di alta qualità nel tempo e soddisfare le aspettative.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.

• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team.

• Risolvere i problemi: adottare un approccio pragmatico; comprendere il valore dell'adozione di soluzioni tecniche generiche piuttosto che dorate.

• Gestire il Sé: lavorare bene autonomamente; svolgere attività e compiti senza sollecitare.
 Capacità linguistiche:
 Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
 La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
 Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 29.11.2026 a 23:59 CET .
 Condizioni di lavoro
 Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (3 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
 Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
 Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite
 Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
 Grado di lavoro: 3-4

Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
 Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
 Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partecipa!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
 Das CERN ATLAS Team spielt eine wichtige Rolle beim Bau des zukünftigen Silizium ATLAS Inner Trackers (ITk). Insbesondere konzentriert sich das Team von CERN Detector Technologies (DT) auf die Realisierung des Pixel Outer Barrels für die ITk. Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen das Design, das Prototyping und die Montage der Stützstrukturen und Werkzeuge sowie die endgültige Integration, Installation und Prüfung des Detektors. Als mechanischer/elektromechanischer Techniker im CERN-DT Team treten Sie der Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) bei und arbeiten eng mit dem Personal der ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) und dem Technical Coordination Team des ATLAS Experiments bei der Konstruktion und Konstruktion des ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer Barrels zusammen.
 Funktionen

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Produktion, dem Test und der Installation der Dienste des Pixel Outer Systems und ihrer Unterstützungsstrukturen (z. B. Trolleys).

• Unterstützen Sie den Entwurf, die Herstellung und die Installation von temporären Diensten und Infrastrukturen für Tests während der Integration des Pixeldetektors.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Integration des Pixel Outer Systems und seiner Einführung in die ITk im SR1-Reinraum und tragen Sie zur Entwicklung und Herstellung der entsprechenden Werkzeuge bei.

• Nehmen Sie an der ITk-Installation in der ATLAS-Höhle teil und unterstützen Sie die Vorbereitung der Pixel-Dienste für die Installation sowie der Verbindungen nach dem Einfügen.

• Dokumentation von Herstellungs- und Installationsverfahren sowie QC-Informationen von Werkzeugen und Produktionsteilen zur Gewährleistung der Rückverfolgbarkeit.

Höheres technisches Diplom oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Präzisionsmechanik oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

Erfahrung:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der konventionellen Präzisionsbearbeitung von metallischen und nichtmetallischen Teilen, sowohl mit konventionellen als auch mit nicht-konventionellen Methoden.

• Gutes Verständnis von mechanischen und elektrischen Zeichnungen, einschließlich geometrischer Toleranzspezifikationen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Montage von komplexen, hochpräzisen mechanischen Systemen mit hohen Qualitätsstandards.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Herstellung und Installation von Kabelbündeln und Kabelbäumen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit strukturellen Fügetechniken, insbesondere Kleben und Orbitalschweißen.
 Erfahrung in den folgenden Bereichen würde als ein Vorteil angesehen werden:

• Vorherige Erfahrung in Computer numerisch gesteuerten (CNC) Maschinen.

• Erfahrung im Einsatz von CAD-Software (idealerweise Catia V5) für die 2D- und 3D-Modellierung.

• Vorherige Erfahrung in der CAD-CAM-Programmierung (vorzugsweise mit WORKNC).
 Technische Kompetenzen:

• Herstellung von mechanischen Teilen.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von Fügetechniken, Kleben, Schweißen.

• Herstellung von 2D-Zeichnungen und 3D-Modellen (ISO-Dimensionierung, Tolerierung).

• Programmierung und Einsatz von CNC-Werkzeugmaschinen und Bearbeitungszentren.

• Präzisionsmontage von mechanischen Strukturen und Ausrüstungen
 Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Ergebnisse erzielen: qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit pünktlich liefern und Erwartungen erfüllen.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: schnelle und einfallsreiche Anpassung an sich verändernde Prioritäten und Anforderungen.

• Arbeiten in Teams: gut in Gruppen arbeiten und sich leicht in ein Team einfügen; vollständig teilnehmen und eine aktive Rolle bei Teamaktivitäten übernehmen.

• Probleme lösen: einen pragmatischen Ansatz verfolgen; den Wert der Einführung von generischen anstelle von "goldplattierten" technischen Lösungen verstehen.

• Selbstmanagement: gut autonom arbeiten; Aktivitäten und Aufgaben übernehmen, ohne zu veranlassen.
 Sprachkenntnisse:
 Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
 Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
 Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 29.11.2026 um 23:59 Uhr MEZ erreichen.
 Beschäftigungsbedingungen
 Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (3 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
 Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
 Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
 Diese Position umfasst:

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.
 Job Grade: 3-4
 Arbeitsnummer: EP-DT-EO-2026-215-LD
 Arbeitsgebiet: Maschinenbau
 Benchmark Job Title: Mechaniker

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre zu verlängern + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer.
 Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
 Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
 Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
 Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
 L'équipe du CERN ATLAS joue un rôle majeur dans la construction de la future piste interne en silicium ATLAS (ITk). En particulier, l'équipe du CERN Detector Technologies (DT) se concentre sur la réalisation du Pixel Outer Barrel pour l'ITk. Nos activités comprennent la conception, le prototypage et l'assemblage des structures de support et d'outillage ainsi que l'intégration, l'installation et les essais finals du détecteur. En tant que technicien mécanique/électromécanique au sein de l'équipe du CERN-DT, vous rejoindrez la Section d'Ingénierie (EP-DT-EO) et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le personnel du groupe ATLAS (EP-ATL) et l'équipe de coordination technique de l'expérience ATLAS dans la conception et la construction de la Barre extérieure ATLAS ITk Pixel.
 Fonctions

• Participer à la production, à l'essai et à l'installation des services Pixel Outer System et de leurs structures de support (par exemple chariots).

• Soutenir la conception, la fabrication et l'installation de services temporaires et d'infrastructures pour les essais pendant l'intégration du détecteur Pixel.

• Participer directement à l'intégration du Pixel Outer System et à son insertion dans l'ITk dans la salle propre SR1, contribuant ainsi au développement et à la fabrication de l'outillage correspondant.

• Participez à l'installation ITk dans la caverne ATLAS, supportant la préparation des services Pixel pour l'installation ainsi que les connexions après insertion.

• Documenter les procédures de fabrication et d'installation ainsi que l'information QC des outils et des pièces de production pour assurer la traçabilité.

Diplôme technique supérieur ou expérience équivalente dans le domaine de la mécanique de précision ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience démontrée dans l'usinage de précision classique de pièces métalliques et non métalliques, à l'aide de méthodes conventionnelles et non conventionnelles.

• Bonne compréhension des dessins mécaniques et électriques, y compris les spécifications de tolérance géométrique.

• Expérience démontrée dans l'assemblage de systèmes mécaniques complexes de haute précision avec des normes de qualité élevées.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la fabrication et l'installation de faisceaux de câbles et de harnais.

• Expérience éprouvée des techniques d'assemblage structural, notamment le collage adhésif et le soudage orbital.
 L'expérience dans les domaines suivants serait considérée comme un atout :

• Expérience antérieure dans les machines à commande numérique par ordinateur (CNC).

• Expérience de l'utilisation du logiciel CAO (idéalement Catia V5) pour la modélisation 2D et 3D.

• Expérience antérieure en programmation CAO-CAM (de préférence en utilisant WORKNC).
 Compétences techniques:

• Fabrication de pièces mécaniques.

• Connaissance et application des techniques d'assemblage, colle, soudage.

• Production de dessins 2D et de modèles 3D (dimensionnement ISO, tolérance).

• Programmation et utilisation de machines-outils et de centres d'usinage CNC.

• Montage de précision des structures et équipements mécaniques
 Compétences comportementales :

• Atteindre des résultats : fournir un travail de haute qualité dans les délais et répondre aux attentes.

• Démontrer la souplesse : s'adapter rapidement et avec ressources à l'évolution des priorités et des besoins.

• Travailler en équipe : bien travailler en groupe et s'intégrer facilement dans une équipe; participer pleinement et jouer un rôle actif dans les activités de l'équipe.

• Résoudre les problèmes : adopter une approche pragmatique; comprendre la valeur de l'adoption de solutions techniques génériques plutôt que plaquées or.

• Gestion de soi : bien travailler de manière autonome; entreprendre des activités et des tâches sans enclencher.
 Compétences linguistiques :
 Anglais ou français parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre l'autre langue.

Admissibilité et date de clôture:
 La diversité fait partie intégrante de la mission du CERN depuis sa fondation et constitue une valeur établie pour l'Organisation. Notre réussite repose sur l'emploi d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures de tous les États membres et États membres associés .
 Cette vacance sera comblée dès que possible, et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard le 29.11.2026 à 23:59 CET .
 Conditions d'emploi
 Type de contrat: Contrat à durée limitée (3 ans). Sous réserve de certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent demander un emploi pour une durée indéterminée.
 Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
 Flexibilité de l'emploi : entièrement sur place
 Cette position implique:

• Travail dans les zones de rayonnement.

• Interventions dans des installations souterraines.

• Un permis de conduire valide.

• Travailler pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés officiels, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.
 Niveau d'emploi: 3-4
 Référence du poste: EP-DT-EO-2026-215-LD
 Domaine de travail: Génie mécanique
 Titre du poste-repère : Technicien en mécanique

Avantages globaux

• Un salaire concurrentiel (sans impôt), en hausse en fonction de vos années d'expérience pertinente.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Un forfait de réinstallation (subvention d'installation, déménagement, frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 8 ans + éligibilité à un contrat de durée indéterminée.
 Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible !
 Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
 Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.
 Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

jobs.description:
Introduction:
 You will join the Technology Department's Machine Protection and Electrical Integrity (MPE) Group , which develops and maintains systems that protect accelerator equipment, including magnets and particle-beam-related installations.
 Working in a collaborative team of software engineers, you will design, develop and maintain reliable software that supports the safe and efficient operation of the Large Hadron Collider and its injector complex. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, collaborate with experts across different disciplines and contribute to systems that are essential to CERN's scientific mission.
 Functions:

• Design, implement, test and maintain software components that interface with equipment protection and interlock systems .

• Monitor deployed applications, investigate technical issues and improve reliability, availability and maintainability.

• Work with engineers, technical specialists and accelerator operations teams during commissioning, testing and operation.

• Understand user requirements, contribute to technical decisions and help deliver sustainable software solutions.

• Collaborate with colleagues to strengthen development workflows, automated testing, continuous integration and software quality, including exploring AI-assisted development tools where appropriate.

• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to colleagues and students.

• Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computing, Physics or Engineering or a related field.
 Experience:

• Solid software engineering experience, including proficiency in Java and/or C++.

• Experience in designing, developing, testing and maintaining software throughout its lifecycle.

• Proficiency with software development practices such as version control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery.

• Strong technical acumen in translating complex requirements into robust, efficient, and maintainable solutions.
 Technical competencies:

• Development of application software: core software design principles and application development.

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures: including Agile methodologies (Kanban, Scrum), Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery, Quality Assurance and DevOps.

• Capturing and analysis of requirements for ICT systems: working with end users to understand their needs and providing corresponding technical solutions.

• Installation, operation and maintenance (preventive and corrective) of computing systems: including monitoring, diagnosing and support of live, operational systems.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Building Relationships: being able to put self in the shoes of others in order to understand their needs and interests.
 Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 29.11.2026 at 23:59 CET.
 Employment Conditions:
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Hybrid
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: TE-MPE-CB-2026-213-LD
 Field of work: Information Technologies
 Benchmark Job Title: Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

jobs.description:
As a Shipping Officer in CERN's Shipping Unit, you will organise and coordinate the import and export transportation of goods worldwide by road, air, sea, and rail. You will manage a wide range of shipments, including chemicals, radioactive materials, dual-use items, and other regulated goods, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant transport operations.
 You will coordinate transport requests, prepare documentation and quotations, advise CERN users, and ensure compliance with international regulations, contributing to the smooth and reliable movement of goods across CERN's global supply chain.
 Your responsibilities:

• Review, correct, and validate transport requests, and organise import and export shipments by road, air, sea, and rail.

• Ensure compliance with transport, customs, and dangerous goods regulations, and prepare and verify transport and customs documentation.

• Coordinate shipments with carriers, freight forwarders, and internal stakeholders, track shipments, and ensure timely delivery.

• Advise CERN users on transport and logistics solutions, prepare transport quotations, and recommend the most suitable shipping options.

• Verify and approve transport invoices, and resolve transport issues, claims, and delivery disputes.

• Provide excellent customer service and respond to users' transport-related enquiries.

• Support continuous improvement of shipping processes and logistics tools.
 Your profile:

• Some experience in organising international transport operations, including customer service and coordination with various partners across the transport industry.

• Some initial exposure to Incoterms® and their application in international trade and transport.

• Some experience in writing clear and structured procedures and work instructions.
 Skills:

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a strong customer and service-oriented mindset.

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to effectively manage priorities and adapt to a dynamic working environment.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Commercial Business Administration (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 19.11.2026 at 23:59 CET.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-January-2027
 Job reference: SCE-SSC-SC-2026-248-GRAE

Ti unirai all'ufficio di progettazione e documentazione elettrica (EN-EL-DDO). Si assumerà un ruolo di progettazione elettrica di supporto. Ciò includerà la creazione e la modifica di disegni elettrici, la progettazione di reti di distribuzione a bassa tensione, il dimensionamento dei cavi, il dimensionamento delle attrezzature, gli studi di protezione LV e il supporto generale per i progettisti elettrici senior. Con il tempo sarà necessario assumere compiti di progettazione di aumentare la complessità. Inoltre, supervisionerai varie attività legate alla qualità all'interno del Design Office, come la gestione dell'ufficio stampa e la manutenzione e l'aggiornamento dei modelli.
Questa è l'occasione perfetta per un tecnico junior per stabilire ulteriormente la loro conoscenza esistente dei circuiti di distribuzione a bassa tensione mettendolo in pratica.
Le tue responsabilità:

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Electrical Engineering Group (EN-EL) at CERN is responsible for the electrical power-distribution network (from 400 kV to 400/230V), for the fibre-optics infrastructure, and for signal and DC-power cabling for the accelerator complex.
You will join the electrical Design and Documentation Office (EN-EL-DDO). You will take on a support electrical designer role. This will include the creation and modification of electrical drawings, design of low voltage distribution networks, cable sizing, equipment sizing, LV protection studies and the general support to senior electrical designers. With time you will be required to take on design tasks of increasing complexity. In addition, you will oversee various quality-related activities within the Design Office, such as the management of the printing office and the maintenance and updating of templates.
This is the perfect opportunity for a junior technician to further establish their existing knowledge of low voltage distribution circuits by putting it into practice.
Your responsibilities:

• Preparing design drawings using CAD software.

• Preparing calculation notes using ElecCalc/Caneco BT or similar.

• Preparing bills of material and cabling tables for electrical-related equipment in Excel.

• Updating excel based design templates.

• General quality related tasks in the design office.
Your profile:
Demonstrated experience in:

• The design of Low voltage distribution networks, cable sizing and selectivity studies.

• Producing drawings in AutoCAD or similar.

• The intermediate level of Microsoft EXCEL.
Skills:

• An understanding of low voltage distribution networks (selectivity, completing calculation notes, knowledge of European LV standards, protection, protection of circuits for indirect contact, knowledge of different types of earthing systems).

• An understanding of power systems; voltage drop calculations, short circuit calculations, understanding fault levels, dimensioning of cables.

• Experience on low voltage design calculation tools (ElecCalc, Caneco or similar software).

• Proficient in AutoCAD or similar.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Beneficial skills/or knowledge:

• Experience on the design of lighting systems for buildings and external areas using DIALux.

• Experience with E-PLAN or similar software.

• Experience in the design of medium voltage distribution networks.

• Motivated candidates without direct design office experience would still be considered.
Eligibility criteria:

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-January-2027
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
